title: UN General Assembly Faces Contentious Vote on Iran Nuclear Enforcement
detail: A contentious UN vote on Iran's nuclear program is expected before the General Assembly session closes; diplomatic blocs are split on enforcement measures. The vote comes amid heightened international scrutiny of Iran's nuclear activities and ongoing tensions between Western powers and Iran's allies over proposed enforcement mechanisms.

title: IAEA Formally Confirms Syria Built Secret Nuclear Reactor Under Assad with Iran-Linked Proliferation Implications
detail: The IAEA formally confirmed that Syria secretly constructed a nuclear reactor in Deir Az Zor under Bashar al-Assad's government — a significant proliferation disclosure. The confirmation carries implications for Iran-linked nuclear networks, as Syria had historically maintained close ties with Iran and Hezbollah. The revelation raises further concerns about nuclear technology transfer across the region.
